name: Fermata
description: Hold: an arc with a dot beneath it, told to last as long as it likes.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 20%; width: 88%; height: 88%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 68%, #000 68%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 68%, #000 68%); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 50%, 0 50%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 50%, 0 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 44%; top: 40%; width: 12%; height: 12%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
